Hi Naomi,

Thanks for taking this — quick context: one of our SeedFoundry portfolio startups (Droplet Labs) signed up for Redwood via the public PLG flow last week and claimed they have an accelerator award that should convert into platform credits. We require a short attestation from Redwood confirming that accounts created through self-serve PLG are eligible for accelerator program credits and a brief verification of the account email domains to confirm the applicant is the org named in our acceptance letter.

Can you confirm Redwood’s process and provide an attestation letter (one paragraph + template language) that we can attach to our grant issuance? Ideally we can close this today — the founders are requesting redemption instructions and the grant team needs the attestation file attached to the grant issuance.

Hi Sasha — thanks for the note and for attaching the acceptance materials. Short answer: yes, PLG signups are eligible for accelerator credits provided we can verify account ownership and that the company appears on your official cohort list.

Next steps I propose so we can get an attestation over to you today:
• We will verify the account owner email and match the company name in your acceptance letter against our signup metadata (account creation date, signup email domain).
• I’ll prepare a one-paragraph attestation on Redwood letterhead confirming eligibility and the scope of credits (non-transferable, applied to account ID) and include the HubSpot deal id we will record.
• Ben / Monica: can one of you pull the Droplet Labs account record and confirm the signup email domain and account ID? If there are any org-level aliases, note them here.

Sasha: once we confirm, I’ll send the attestation PDF and a redemption token redemption guide (self-serve flow) and we can copy you on the HubSpot activity so you have a reference.

Naomi

Hi Sasha — all set. Quick summary and what I attached for your grant file: 

1) Attestation: Redwood confirms that the account acct_0xA9c3 (sign-up email founders@dropletlabs.com) was created via our public PLG signup flow on 2026-08-18 and is owned by Droplet Labs, which is a SeedFoundry cohort company. We attest that Droplet Labs is eligible for the SeedFoundry accelerator credit award and that Redwood will apply a USD 5,000 promotional credit to the referenced account. (See attached: redwood_attestation_SeedFoundry_DropletLabs.pdf)

2) Issuance: Finance-approved. I requested issuance of a self-serve promotional credit token and applied the credits directly to acct_0xA9c3. The credits are non-transferable and will appear on the account as a promo with expiration 2027-02-18.

3) Redemption instructions: founders can use the credits automatically when they call the Redwood billing/usage APIs or via the Console under Billing -> Credits (we linked the grant id RDW-ACC-20260822-87). If founders need a redemption token instead of direct application, let me know and we’ll generate a one-time redemption link.

Attachments: [redwood_attestation_SeedFoundry_DropletLabs.pdf (PDF, 3KB)]

If you’d like me to drop the attestation into the Drive link you provided, confirm and I’ll push it there as well. Happy to jump on a 15-min call if you or the founders want a quick walkthrough of the console redemption flow.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Growth, Redwood Inference
